mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, slot_name, slot_value, polarity, source, version, active, created_at, updated_at FROM city_preference_fact WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND active = 1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO city_preference_fact ( user_id, slot_name, slot_value, polarity, source, version, active, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{slotName}, #{slotValue}, #{polarity}, #{source}, 1, 1, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source = VALUES(source), active = 1, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW()
